facts.statement: Deliverable: a presentation continuing the same document as the previous assignment.
Recommended length is open; the brief supplies an 11-section outline.
The brand is Off Hours - D2C sleep & recovery, melatonin-free night-drink sachets, Mumbai + Bengaluru.
Price points are 999 trial kit and 1,899/month subscription - the deck must not contradict them.
Business goal: 1,000 paying subscribed households within 12 months, Mumbai + Bengaluru.
Persona: Meera Nair, 32, Product Manager, Bengaluru (Koramangala).
Part 1 names four non-priorities: television & print; mass display / broad awareness bursts; celebrity influencer blitzes; heavy marketplace-ads dependence.
Part 1 sequences partnerships and mass awareness after the subscriber base makes them worth doing (Phase 2).
Part 1 primary channels are Instagram Reels/short video, search, own storefront + UPI, WhatsApp concierge, sleep-journal e-mail.
Voice established in Part 1: understated, proof-led, calm; no hype.
Audience excludes insomniacs seeking clinical treatment and price-first general supplement buyers.
